question: Why do we bare our teeth when we’re happy?
answer: The page compares one bared-teeth face across four species: rhesus, Tonkean, chimp and human. Its reveal is that our smile likely began as "don't hurt me". Tolerant societies turned it into "we're friends".
move: Our smile likely began as “don’t hurt me”. Tolerant societies made it “we’re friends”.
